    parameter DATA_WIDTH=32,

    parameter OUT_WIDTH=DATA_WIDTH+$clog2(LENGTH),
    parameter DELAT_STAGES=$clog2(LENGTH)

(

    output signed [OUT_WIDTH-1:0] out_sum
);

    wire signed [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] sums [LENGTH/2-1:0];
    wire signed [OUT_WIDTH-1:0] out_sum_int;
    assign addends = in_addends[LENGTH*DATA_WIDTH-1:0];
    assign out_sum = out_sum_int;
    genvar i;
    generate
        if (LENGTH == 1) begin
            if (DELAT_STAGES == 0) begin
                assign out_sum_int = addends[0];
            end else begin
                reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] out_sum_int_reg;
                always @(posedge clk) begin
                    if (rst) begin
                        out_sum_int_reg <= 0;
                    end else begin
                        if (in_advance) begin
                            out_sum_int_reg <= addends[0];
                        end
                    end
                end
                assign out_sum_int = out_sum_int_reg;
            end
        end else begin
            for (i = 0; i < LENGTH/2; i = i + 1) begin
                AdderTreePipelined #(
                    .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
                    .LENGTH(LENGTH/2),
                    .OUT_WIDTH(OUT_WIDTH),

                    .clk(clk),
                    .in_advance(in_advance),

                .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
                .LENGTH(LENGTH/2),
                .OUT_WIDTH(OUT_WIDTH),
                .DELAT_STAGES(DELAT_STAGES-1)
            ) adder_tree_pipelined (
                .rst(rst),
                .clk(clk),
                .in_advance(in_advance),
                .in_addends({sums[LENGTH/4-1], sums[LENGTH/4]}),
                .out_sum(out_sum_int)
            );
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule
